title: Wet Well Air Ionization Odor Control System

onscreen_lines.desc: Bidder offers to perform and completely accomplish the project by furnishing, delivering, and installing a complete wet well air ionization odor control system for municipal wastewater service (as described in the scope of work). The scope of work shall meet or exceed the following specifications in the section as described (provide labor, materials and supervision), in accordance with the requirements contained in the ITB. This shall be a lump sum bid for the completed project.
